title: MEETING: Speed + quality: how we hit the 98/95 bar faster
desc: goal: Every member brings a position + 1-3 concrete proposals to make the project faster and better (each proposal names what it changes and what it is worth); the room picks the best and turns them into tasks. Carlo attends and can type. Prep is required before the start.
